meta.audience: A class, or a small group sharing one device, working through maths set in the worlds.
meta.why: Maths is checked, not trusted: the gate reads whether the stations were passed with no misconception or unsafe shortcut, and the teacher decides what the result evidences against the school's own curriculum.
meta.hostNotes: The SmartCiti.X side of the flow contract only (docs/flowhub.md, docs/k12.md): nothing here states how Cognition.X or any other host stores or presents it. Any host that speaks the contract loads, starts and listens; the teacher gate reads this run's own attempt records.
meta.lowConnectivity: Works offline once the page has loaded; the run waits in this browser's own storage, so a lost connection loses nothing.

nodes.title: Pre-brief — measuring and scaling the court
nodes.why: The first station's own study card, read before the class starts, so everyone knows what the lesson is for and what to watch for.

nodes.title: K-12 Practical Maths
nodes.why: The programme itself: SmartCiti.X opens it at the first station the learner has not yet passed, exactly as its own Start button does.

nodes.title: Class check-in
nodes.why: A pause between the stations and the gate to say how it is going. Never scored, and it never leaves the learner's browser.

nodes.title: Teacher gate
nodes.why: The gate reads the programme's key stations from this run's own records: passed, with no misconception or unsafe shortcut. It certifies nothing; the teacher decides what it evidences against the school's own curriculum.

nodes.title: End-of-lesson check-in
nodes.why: The lesson closes on the learner's own answer about how it went, not on a score.
